title: The last page of a product list is always missing
requirement: Customers report that the final page of the catalogue never shows: with 25 products and 10 per page they see pages 1 and 2 and then nothing. page_count in shop/paging.py and the slice in page_items look wrong. Fix the paging so every product is on exactly one page.
acceptance: page_items returns the remaining products on the last page
pages beyond the last are empty
